sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of Proceeds We will not receive any proceeds from the resale of shares of Common Stock included in this prospectus by the Selling Stockholders. However, under certain circumstances, we may receive up to $35.9 million in aggregate gross proceeds from the conversion of the Series B Preferred Stock by the Selling Stockholders. We expect to use the net proceeds that we receive from the conversion of the Series B Preferred Stock, if any, primarily for working capital and general corporate purposes and for purposes of the transactions that are part of our Transformation Plan. We have not yet determined the amount of net proceeds, if any, to be used specifically for any of the foregoing purposes. See the section titled “ Use of Proceeds .”.
